description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_ClearAllCache, which implements a method to clear all cached data within the Smarty templating engine. It includes a method clearAllCache that interacts with cache resources to delete cache files.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_ClearAllCache
classes.description: A class that provides functionality to clear all cache in Smarty

methods.name: clearAllCache
methods.description: Clears all cached content by calling cache resource clearAll and clearing template cache.
